metrics_finding.finding: order-service CPU utilization increased from baseline to failure, while memory utilization decreased and mean latency decreased.

evidence_summary.summary: Order service CPU utilization increased, while memory utilization decreased and mean latency decreased.

report.suggested_fix: Investigate and optimize order-service resources to ensure balanced CPU, memory, and latency.

report_text.en: The root cause of the incident is likely related to a resource imbalance in the order service. Further investigation is required to determine the exact cause and implement a fix.
report_text.hi: अनुपस्थिति का मुख्य कारण संभवतः ऑर्डर सेवा के संसाधनों में असंतुलन है। और अधिक विस्तार से जांच करने की आवश्यकता है ताकि सटीक कारण निर्धारित किया जा सके और एक समाधान लागू किया जा सके।
